author: /root/backend_audit
scope: Static review of the exact implementation and review of author-executed test logs; reviewer did not run build, tests or performance measurements.
checks: Disabled TimingTrace allocates no trace state and performs no added clock read or lock.
Tracing does not enter source query keys, object action keys, target or optimization options.
Current independent Verify, cached machine preflight and native object write/link remain on their original paths.
Publication validation, final publication and object-cache commit preserve original order; failures cannot acquire publication authority.
Request spans include source discovery and session capacity eviction; legacy report.seconds retains its narrower pre-existing boundary.
Parent spans include children; parallel unit spans use a shared origin and unit identifiers. JSON explicitly forbids summing nested or overlapping spans as wall or CPU time.
Single-unit Clang code generation plus linking is explicitly labelled clang_compile_and_link.
Worker join and deterministic unit-id error selection remain unchanged.
Early return and unwinding close scopes without converting incomplete work to success.
Final fix changes only crate-root field visibility from invalid pub(super) to pub(crate).

preserved_failure.error: E0433: pub(super) at the crate root has no legal parent module
preserved_failure.fix: One field visibility changes to pub(crate); no timing, cache or compilation semantics change.

limitations: Default report JSON adds timings:null; it is not byte-for-byte identical to prior JSON.
Enabled trace collection overhead is included in enclosing scopes; trace samples do not establish uninstrumented performance gains.
The recorded finite tests were executed by the author, not rerun by the reviewer.
No full workspace gate, complete language safety proof, all-target guarantee or product performance acceptance is claimed.
